title: FX New York reversal after London trend exhaustion
thesis: Some FX majors may reverse during New York after a one-way London trend if price rejects the London extension after US liquidity enters.
market_intuition: London continuation that fails during the New York handoff may create a structured reversal when the move is extended and participation shifts.
entry_idea: Enter reversal after New York open if price closes back inside the London extension zone.
exit_idea: Exit at London midpoint, fixed target, or New York lunch cutoff.
risk_assumption: Stop beyond London extreme with fixed fractional risk.
cost_slippage_assumption: Use pair spread and slippage stress around session handoff.
data_source: Broker FX OHLCV with explicit session calendar.
disproof_condition: Reject if reversal only works in one pair or is erased by one spread-width extra cost.

clarification_answers.q_london_window: Use 07:00-12:00 UTC for London trend measurement.
clarification_answers.q_ny_window: Use 13:30-16:00 UTC for initial New York reversal entries.
